summary: Iteration 131: Comprehensive testing of War Room Paging, Tech Roster, Blueprints, and Time-aware Standups. All 29 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirmed all new features are working correctly.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - cosmetic only, charts still render

critical_code_review_comments: HuduSuggestionsPanel has nested button elements causing React hydration warnings - should refactor to avoid button inside button
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for tech roster, blueprints, and war rooms
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 131 added 4 major features: (1) War Room Paging with auto-escalation and magic-link ack, (2) Tech Roster CRUD with tier management, (3) Ticket Blueprints with fields/checklist and resolve gate, (4) Time-aware standup digest. All backend APIs verified working. Frontend pages /tech-roster, /blueprints, /warroom all functional. Ticket detail Blueprint tab shows empty state with picker when no blueprint applied. Client detail has Blueprints tab for assigning blueprints per client.

standup_digest.details: GET /api/ai/standup-digest returns correct slot (morning/afternoon/evening) based on hour_override. slot_label and slot_icon match expected values.

tech_roster.details: Full CRUD working. Name required validation. escalation_tier clamps to 1-3. preferred_channels filters invalid values.

blueprints.details: Full CRUD working. Name required. Fields validation skips invalid types. Checklist skips empty labels. DELETE soft-archives (active=false).

client_blueprint_linking.details: GET/PUT /api/clients/{id}/blueprints working. default_blueprint_id must be in blueprint_ids (400 if not).

ticket_blueprint_application.details: POST /api/tickets/{id}/apply-blueprint applies blueprint. PUT /api/tickets/{id}/blueprint-fields patches worksheet. POST toggle checklist items with done_by/done_at.

blueprint_gate.details: PUT /api/tickets/{id} with status=resolved returns 400 when require_completion=true and required items incomplete. Error message lists missing items.

warroom_paging.details: POST /api/warroom/{id}/page creates pages. auto_escalate=true sets escalation_tier=1 and next_escalation_at. Tier-1 techs get status='sent'.

magic_link_ack.details: GET /api/warroom/page/ack/{token} works WITHOUT auth, returns HTML 200 with 'Thanks'. Page status transitions to 'ack'. Idempotent on re-click.

resend_page.details: POST /api/warroom/{id}/page/{page_id}/resend re-dispatches page with updated sent_at and dispatch_results.

frontend_tech_roster.details: /tech-roster page loads. Add dialog opens with name/role/email/mobile/channels/tier fields.

frontend_blueprints.details: /blueprints page loads with list. New Blueprint dialog has name, require_completion toggle, add field/checklist buttons, save button.

frontend_warroom_paging.details: War Room detail has 'Page Team' button. Dialog shows roster, channel chips (email/sms/push/slack/teams), auto-escalate switch, grace input, fire button.

frontend_ticket_blueprint_tab.details: Ticket detail has Blueprint tab. Empty state shows picker with 'Pick a blueprint...' dropdown and Apply button.

frontend_client_blueprints_tab.details: Client detail has Blueprints tab. Shows assigned blueprints with checkboxes and 'Set default' star button.

frontend_standup_banner.details: Dashboard shows Morning Standup banner with correct slot-specific label and icon.
